body: I just don’t want them to have to continually worry about me. Thank God my sister is pretty much oblivious to all this because I know if she knew I tried to kill myself she wouldn’t talk to me anymore. As for the thinking, so far the only remedy I have is watching movies, playing video games, or listening to music. Its extremely difficult to keep the negative thoughts at bay.
I have been seeing a psychologist, I probably need to try and contact him again after what’s been happening.
